csv.title: Import CSV
csv.hint: CSV in the SAML-D format, without the evaluation columns. Up to 20 MB or 200 thousand rows; all or nothing.

errors.linesTooLong: Excessively long lines. Check the CSV format.
errors.invalid: Invalid CSV: check delimiters, quotes and columns.
errors.headers: The CSV must contain exactly the 11 SAML-D transaction columns. Missing: {missing}. Remove extra or duplicated columns.
errors.https: Connection credentials require an HTTPS API. HTTP is only allowed on localhost.

connections.title: External database connections
connections.intro: Reads transactions from a Postgres table in the SAML-D format, always in read-only mode. Test first: the report shows what matches the format and whether the data continues the current dataset.
connections.removeNote: The connection and the encrypted password cease to exist and monitoring of this source stops. Transactions that already entered the dataset stay there. The removal is recorded in the audit log.
connections.linked: This connection is already linked to the dataset {dataset}.
connections.saved: Connection saved. The password was encrypted and will not be shown again.

form.name: Connection name
form.note: The password is encrypted when saved and never shown again. The control column (date/time or increasing number) lets you read only what is new. Reading is always read-only.

questions.q1: 1. How does it relate to the current data?
questions.destination: Destination: dataset {dataset}. Dates that cross closed weeks are refused.
questions.control: Control column (to read only what is new)

extend.label: Continues the current data
extend.hint: Same accounts, following periods. The transactions go into the selected dataset.

new_dataset.label: Another dataset with the same structure
new_dataset.hint: Creates a separate dataset, with its own queue, periods and history.

history.label: Analyze the history now
history.hint: Imports everything already in the table and processes it.

follow.label: Follow only what arrives
follow.hint: Ignores what already exists; each run reads the new rows through the control column.

both.label: Both
both.hint: Imports the history and keeps reading the new rows.

report.title: Compatibility report

datesText.continue: The dates continue right after the end of the current data.
datesText.overlap: The dates cross periods of the current dataset.
datesText.other_era: The dates are from another era.
datesText.empty_dataset: The current dataset has no transactions to compare yet.

report.accountsKnown: {pct} of the {count} sample accounts already exist in the current dataset.
report.noAccounts: No accounts to compare in the sample.
report.rowsUncounted: Not counted (the table is too large to count right now)
report.truthYes: Yes: the model can be measured and, later, retrained.
report.truthNo: No: the model gives the scores, but there is no way to measure or retrain.
